description: Cycles are found over reconstructed spans. In c, the inner r covers A and the outer r covers A and a synthetic T. Both project to [0, 1), but their reconstructed spans differ, so c is no cycle, and it is a second reading (engine §7.7).
grammar:
%ambiguity-resolution late-elision elision-only
%rule text a | b | c
%rule a A [+T] [+T]
%rule b A [+T] [+T] [+T]
%rule c r T
%rule r r T | A
